name: cmd_denoise_models_download
description: Download Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list) in the background over HTTPS with lightcraft-fetch. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, installed and chosen by itself; `denoise.models.downloads` shows how far it is.
